claim_or_question: What statutory consent and data protection obligations govern student personal data and children data?
title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (Act No. 22 of 2023)
publisher: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) / Gazette of India
applicability: Data fiduciary obligations; parental consent for minors (<18); purpose limitation and consent withdrawal
limitations: Enforcement framework and Data Protection Board operational rules are phased in.

claim_or_question: How does DigiLocker/NAD authenticate academic records and structure verification?
title: National Academic Depository (NAD) FAQs and Technical Model
publisher: National e-Governance Division (NeGD) / MeitY / Ministry of Education
applicability: Digital signature verification; QR-code tamper-proofing; issuer registration
limitations: Direct production gateway access requires formal institutional onboarding with DigiLocker/NAD.

claim_or_question: How is APAAR ID created and what are parental consent requirements?
title: APAAR FAQs and Operational Guidance
publisher: Ministry of Education / Department of School Education and Literacy
applicability: APAAR 12-digit generation; demographic validation; Aadhaar mapping consent; voluntary nature
limitations: Operational guidance reflects school-to-higher-education transition; higher ed workflow relies on ABC.

claim_or_question: What legal framework guarantees validity of digital credentials and audit confidentiality?
title: Information Technology Act 2000 (amended 2008)
publisher: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology / Legislative Department
applicability: Electronic record equivalence; digital signature validity; unauthorized disclosure penalties
limitations: Section 43A transitions to DPDP Act; electronic evidentiary rules apply under Section 65B.
